text: Fixing #6454: release_native_objects_for_shutdown() released a single snapshot of roots, so an object created inside another object's Destroy during QUIT was bulk-discarded without its own Destroy/release. Real VFP9 09.00.0000.7423 (Wine, retained probe in temp/vfp9-probes/shutdown-new-object-6454) runs Destroy for every such object, the whole chain Maker->Late->Late2, so shutdown now releases to a fixed point (attempted-set, bound of 1024 releases with a single runtime.shutdown.object_release_limit event for runaway chains). Fail-first: chain test got 'M' before, 'MLX' after; adversarial loop test bounded.
